warranty.notes: 60% of usable energy at 10 years or the Minimum Throughput Energy, whichever comes first. Per tower: 2 modules 15.41 MWh, 3 modules 23.12 MWh, 4 modules 30.82 MWh, 5 modules 38.53 MWh. Throughput is the total output (discharged) energy recorded by the battery's control module.
